caption: The drawing consists of six rectangular segments, each with a distinct pattern and color scheme, arranged in a grid format. The top left segment features a repeating pattern of small red and yellow flowers with thin yellow stems on a light blue background, divided by horizontal and vertical white lines forming squares. The top center segment has a dense arrangement of beige and light brown flowers with greenish leaves on a black background, creating a floral motif. The top right segment displays alternating circular emblems, half colored blue and yellow, half red and green, each containing a stylized floral design, set against a solid brown background. The bottom left segment is brown with horizontal stripes, featuring scattered, small abstract shapes in red, blue, and yellow. The bottom center segment alternates vertical, wide stripes of olive green and dark red with narrow yellow dotted lines between the stripes. The bottom right segment consists of large, stylized blue leaves with dark blue veins, placed diagonally on a lighter blue background with horizontal stripes. The artist’s signature, "E. WHITE," appears near the lower right corner outside the grid.
title: Materials from Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
